figurative_meaning_bn: মলিন; বিষণ্ণ; ব্যবহৃত হাঁড়ির ন্যায় কালো
figurative_meaning_en: dull; gloomy; black like a used pot
example_sentences_in_bangla: রাগ করে তার মুখ হাঁড়িপানা হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: In anger, his face turned as black as a pot.
Due to sadness, his appearance looks dull and gloomy.
note: Refers to the soot-covered appearance of traditional earthen or metal pots used in cooking.
